sources.title: Standard Thermodynamic Properties for Selected Substances (Chemistry 2e, appendix)
sources.supports: Standard enthalpies of formation at 298 K; reaction enthalpies by Hess's law: calcination +191.59 kJ/mol, hydration -64.47 kJ/mol, carbon combustion -393.51 kJ/mol.
sources.doesNotVerify: Temperature dependence, decomposition temperature or CO2 equilibrium, reaction rates, real limestone/shell composition, kiln performance. Other tables commonly list CaCO3 near -1207 kJ/mol (not checked here); the difference is unresolved.
